expectations.text: Keeps equipment advice brief and secondary (audio first if mentioned)
expectations.evidence: Gear is clearly secondary. Section 1 refuses 'Spending first' because 'Gear doesn't decide whether this works. The moderator and the pre-flight checklist do.' Equipment appears only in section 11 of 12, which opens with 'Gear is the smallest part of this. Order of spend: audio, stability, then camera, then overlays.' The mic is the first item to buy, and the section has a long 'Don't buy yet' list. It is not fully brief: section 11 still has Buy, Optional, Free and Don't-buy lists, plus a four-scene OBS overlay breakdown, which is more detail than a short secondary note needs.

expectations.text: Keeps equipment advice brief and secondary (audio first if mentioned)
expectations.evidence: Audio does come first. The microphone is the first row of the table, which says 'Audio matters more than video,' and the headphones follow. The rest of the item is not met. The response opens with a spend figure ('Spend about $300–450 now'). Equipment is section 1, placed before the show format. It gets a 7-row table with brands and price ranges, plus three extra checks (second monitor, font size, moderation), and it comes back again in Next steps. Equipment is the first and one of the most detailed parts of the answer, so it is neither brief nor secondary.
